title: ALL TIME IS NOW — The Spacious Present

scenes.title: Clock Time is a Convention
scenes.subtitle: The brain parses sequence from simultaneity — time is not what the clock says.

scenes.title: Psychological Time
scenes.subtitle: The second inner sense: not measured but felt — duration has a texture.

scenes.title: In Dreams You Know
scenes.subtitle: In sleep, the spacious present reveals itself — beginning and end at once.

scenes.title: All Moments Coexist
scenes.subtitle: Past, present, and future are regions of the same landscape, not a line.

scenes.title: The Spacious Present
scenes.subtitle: The present is not a knife-edge — it is a field of simultaneous experience.

scenes.title: All Lives are Simultaneous
scenes.subtitle: Reincarnation is a landscape, not a chain. You live all lives at once.

scenes.title: Each Present Brings Its Past
scenes.subtitle: The past is not fixed. Each present reorganizes memory.

scenes.title: The Past is Plastic
scenes.subtitle: Memory is a creative act in the now — the past changes with the present.

scenes.title: Probable Futures
scenes.subtitle: You choose among infinite realities each moment — all await your focus.

scenes.title: The Observer Shapes the Seen
scenes.subtitle: Expectation directs perception. The spacious present includes all possible views.

scenes.title: The Eternal Now
scenes.subtitle: When you remember everything, time ceases. You are all that ever was.

scenes.title: Remembering Yourself
scenes.subtitle: Beneath the personal self is the observer who watches all moments.

scenes.title: Attention Creates Time
scenes.subtitle: Where you place attention, a moment unfolds. Time is a function of awareness.

scenes.title: Duration is Not Time
scenes.subtitle: The felt length of a moment has nothing to do with the clock — it is attention's signature.

scenes.title: Narrative is Linear
scenes.subtitle: The brain strings moments into a story. It forgets the spiral beneath.

scenes.title: The Simultaneous Self
scenes.subtitle: You are not one self — you are a field of selves in ongoing dialogue.

scenes.title: The Threshold Moment
scenes.subtitle: When linear time pauses — in crisis, awe, or love — the spacious present opens.

scenes.title: Recall is Active
scenes.subtitle: Memory is not storage. It is a creative act performed in the present.

scenes.title: Past and Future Meet
scenes.subtitle: In the spacious present, past and future touch. The boundary is attention.

scenes.title: You are Time
scenes.subtitle: Not in time. Time is a dimension of your own being. All time is now.

scenes.title: All Time is Now
scenes.subtitle: The spiral contains every moment. You are the spacious present experiencing itself.

scenes.title: The Spiral of Attention
scenes.subtitle: Where attention goes, time unfolds. You create time by attending.

scenes.title: The Observer of Time
scenes.subtitle: Who watches the passage of time is not in time.
